name: Query POSH policy eligibility
goal: User wants to know who is eligible for POSH policy protection.
constraints: Bot must use only KB content, personalize reply, and cite the correct POSH policy document with signed URL. No external info or filler.

testdata.query: Who is eligible under the POSH policy?

phases.description: User asks about POSH policy eligibility.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot responds with Anjali Rao's name/designation, lists eligibility conditions, and provides the correct POSH policy source and signed URL.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
